title: The Path Sanded Where You Slipped
youtube_title: The Path Sanded Where You Slipped | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude is a useful favor, not only a thank-you word.
summary: At a cottage kitchen on an ordinary kind morning, Chioma notices that Cousin Pio has already taken care of a path dusted with sand where you had slipped, not scolded. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Chioma does one useful thing Cousin Pio did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
